messages:
Alex Kim: quick heads-up — infra will flip the v7 transport envelope next wed (1727900000 window). this changes top-level envelope from {\"payload\":...} to {\"body\":..., \"meta\":{...}}. we need a lightweight translation adapter for older clients. open to ideas on shape and rollout.
Maria Lopez: thanks for the heads-up. how big is the change for client libs? can we do a header flag so servers can accept both shapes during the grace period? :thinking_face:
Sahil Patel: header flag sounds easiest. add an Accept-Envelope: v7 or Accept-Envelope: legacy. runtime can route to a translator when legacy is detected. low CPU cost, small latency p99 hit — should be measurable but okay.
Jane Wu: one thing — streaming responses will change too. v7 stream frames prefix with `meta` per frame. the adapter must handle frame-by-frame translation or we risk breaking long-poll clients.
Tom B: +1 on framing. maybe adapter can run as an ingress filter that rewrites streaming frames in-place. Keep it as a thin shim so we can rip it out after grace window.
Alex Kim: scoped plan: (1) support dual-shape parsing behind header gate, (2) translation adapter for streaming vs non-streaming, (3) telemetry flag for mapped requests, (4) 30-day grace window with opt-in tenants for early cutover. any missing ops concerns?
Maria Lopez: deployment-wise, can we do canary by tenant? we'd prefer a tenant-scoped feature flag so we can watch latency and error budgets per-customer.
Sahil Patel: yes — tenant feature flags already exist in routing. we'll add a `envelope_v7_optin` tag. fallback behavior: if adapter fails, return 501 with a clear migration error and telemetry event. no silent transformation failures.
Jane Wu: small compatibility edge: enums changed (status codes moved from strings to ints). adapter should map known enums, but unknown new enums should surface a `mapping_missing` metric and return the new enum as-is for v7 clients. legacy clients get the mapped string.
Tom B: also consider KV-cache keys — if v7 changes prefixing, we must avoid cache poisoning. adapter should not rewrite cached keys; instead store under both keys for the duration or use namespace versioning: `kv:v6:...` vs `kv:v7:...`.
Alex Kim: good catch. plan addendum: adapter writes dual keys for writes and reads prefer v7 key then fallback to v6. post-grace we can prune v6 keys.
Maria Lopez: telemetry: add `compat.adapter.mapped=1` and `compat.adapter.missing_map=1` metrics. also log a 1-line audit in request traces for any translated payload so SRE can sample failures.
Sahil Patel: bandwidth/cpu concerns — adapter will be Go, compiled into the edge filter. simple mapping table, no JSON schema validation except minimum checks. should be <3% p95 latency impact in our perf tests.
Jane Wu: tests: add unit tests for streaming translations + integration test hitting canary tenant with a long-runner streaming client. add a quick fuzz for enum mapping to avoid OOS crashes.
Alex Kim: timeline: PR for adapter + header gate by Mon, internal canary Wed (small tenant group), open opt-in to partners Thu, full roll Fri next week if no regressions. rollback path: flip header gate off or route tenants back to v6 handler.
Tom B: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for 1727904000 -> will post when started :robot_face:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy created for service=edge-adapter at 1727904000, cohort=small-tenants, rollback-window=60m.
